correctness.rationale: The graph automorphism group has exactly eight leader-pair orbits; the unmodified biclique inverse follows from a 2-block Schur complement and deleting one edge is a grounded rank-one Sherman–Morrison correction. Inspected verify.py recomputes all eight exact rational polynomials from the source formulas.json, proves positivity using shifted polynomial coefficient certificates on p>=6,q>=p and the complete p=3/4/5 unbounded strips, and checks all six remaining integer cases. Independent exact grounded Laplacian inverses for (3,3),(3,6),(3,7),(4,4),(4,5),(5,5),(5,6),(6,6),(6,7) matched the claimed optimizer classes and normalized trace (no factor of 1/2). Thus the infinite-domain proof uses symbolic sign certificates, not finite-size extrapolation.
